Create an exam

Those four are the exam's, not the machine's: whoever sits this exam records what you chose here, whatever their own settings say. You can change them afterwards from the exam's row.

The exit code is what you type on a student's machine to end their lockdown. It never reaches their computer — the check happens on the server — so nobody can read it off their laptop. You can look it up here later. Leave it blank and the lockdown falls back to that machine's own passcode.

Add a proctor

Creates an account and gives it proctor rights. A proctor can see every student's ID photo, face photo and screen for their own exams, so only add people who should have that.
